build_actor_critic_learner: build an ActorCriticBase subclass that implements actor and critic loss functions for a custom RL algorithm
create_act_method: create an action selection call using act with exploit mode on a given subjective state
train_learn_batch: train the actor and critic networks on a batch of transitions using learn_batch
compare_policy_learners: compare two ActorCriticBase instances to find differences in networks optimizers and hyperparameters
preprocess_transition_batch: preprocess a transition batch to apply safety constraint weighted rewards before learning
